skills.description: Agentic feed digest using the feed CLI. Fetch, triage, and summarize RSS/Atom/JSON feeds to surface high-signal posts. Use when: (1) reading feeds or catching up on news, (2) user asks for a digest, roundup, or summary of recent posts, (3) user asks what's new or interesting today, (4) user mentions feed, RSS, blogs, or subscriptions.
skills.description_zh: 使用 feed CLI 实现智能信息摘要，获取、筛选并汇总 RSS/Atom/JSON 订阅源，突出高价值帖子。适用于：①阅读订阅或浏览新闻，②用户请求摘要或近期动态，③询问今日新鲜事，④提及 feed、RSS、博客或订阅。
skills.name: Feed Digest
